title: Add bounded baseline-vs-candidate experiment check for OLY-9-05
summary: Add a new athena-core module that defines a bounded baseline-versus-candidate experiment for a change to an engineering method, refuses unbounded or incomplete ones, and decides a verdict from the two arms. Record it as OLY-9-05's mechanism in docs/spec.toml with a measure ending `status: not shown` and the test name. The audience is Athena's spec sweep and the verifier.

defaults_applied.how: New module has unit tests; fmt, clippy and test criteria included.
Criteria run the tests and check refusal and verdict behavior.
One focused new module plus spec entry.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/exploration.rs (Experiment, validate, conclude, record_result: refusals for empty hypothesis, empty approach, zero bound), crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs (pub mod list), crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs (spec sweep treats mechanism 'none' or a blank/unknown-label measure as a gap; measure must end `status: <label>` or `status: not shown`) and crates/athena-core/src/status.rs (labels athena status prints). The new module is a pure library function with no entry point, so no resolution or probing order applies and it is measured directly by unit tests of its own functions. It adds no record or data file under crates/, so check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test are unaffected.

Existing code: extends the bounded-experiment pattern of crates/athena-core/src/exploration.rs and follows the spec-field conventions checked in crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs; docs/spec.toml already holds OLY-9-05 with mechanism 'none'.

Design: a new module crates/athena-core/src/method_experiment.rs with a MethodExperiment (method name, baseline arm, candidate arm, bound in runs, a metric where lower or higher is better), a validate that refuses an empty method, a missing arm, or a zero bound, and a compare that returns Refused, Stopped (runs exceeded bound), or a verdict of Better, Worse, or NoDifference for the candidate. It is not wired into the run pipeline; wiring is out of scope.
Measure is 'cargo test -p athena-core method_experiment; status: not shown' because no `athena status` line reports it, matching OLY-9-04's style.
This adds a refusal rule only for a new type with no past readings, so no past reading is newly refused: expected 0% of newly refused readings.
Environment: none; no CI workflow, push or history read is involved.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml requirement OLY-9-05 has mechanism naming crates/athena-core/src/method_experiment.rs (not 'none'), owner 'Athena', and a measure ending `status: not shown` that names `cargo test -p athena-core method_experiment`.
crates/athena-core/src/method_experiment.rs exists and is declared with `pub mod method_experiment;` in crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs (Grep shows both).

Run `cargo test -p athena-core method_experiment`: tests pass showing a zero-bound, empty-method or missing-arm experiment is refused, runs beyond the bound yield Stopped, and a candidate that beats, trails, or ties the baseline yields Better, Worse, NoDifference respectively. Each test calls the module's functions, so removing the module makes them fail to compile.
Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test`: all pass with no warnings.

out_of_scope: Wiring experiments into the run pipeline, drain or athena status output
Changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows or prompts
departures: Slightly lower cost and time than reference: a small self-contained module modeled on exploration.rs.
